items.description:
Wataru Sajou is infamous in his school for persistently seeking the attention of his crush, Aika Natsukawa. His usual day revolves around shadowing her and confessing his undying love at every turn. However, a moment of epiphany leads Wataru to relinquish his childish behavior and face the reality that she will never return his one-sided feelings. He distances himself from Aika and spends his newfound spare time with his friends and in the company of other lovely girls.

As Wataru moves on, Aika starts approaching him in unusually suggestive ways—making him question whether giving up on his love was the right decision after all.

Wataru Sajou es famoso en su escuela por buscar persistentemente la atención de la persona que le gusta, Aika Natsukawa. Sin embargo, un momento de epifanía lleva a Wataru a renunciar a su comportamiento infantil y enfrentar la realidad de que ella nunca corresponderá a sus sentimientos unilaterales. items.description:
After graduating from a top university with an impressive extracurricular record in the rugby club, Akira Tendou has nailed every step of the way to securing his dream job. On top of that, a beautiful and kind co-worker always brightens his day in the office! Life seems to be going very well for Akira until he slowly realizes that sleepless nights and brutal work are his new reality.

Due to three years of mind-numbing labor in an exploitative company, Akira is unable to recognize the tired, unaccomplished person he has become. On track to losing all passion in life like several of his overworked colleagues, Akira finds his saving grace in the most unexpected way possible—the breakout of a zombie apocalypse.

With the free time he finally has, Akira decides to complete a bucket list of a hundred things he wants to do before he eventually gets turned into a zombie. Although he is surrounded by the dead, Akira has never felt more alive!

Después de graduarse de una de las mejores universidades con un impresionante historial extracurricular en el club de rugby, Akira Tendou ha logrado cada paso del camino para conseguir el trabajo de sus sueños. Además de eso, ¡una compañera de trabajo hermosa y amable siempre alegra su día en la oficina! La vida parece ir muy bien para Akira hasta que poco a poco se da cuenta de que las noches de insomnio y el trabajo brutal son su nueva realidad.

Debido a tres años de trabajo agotador en una empresa explotadora, Akira es incapaz de reconocer la persona cansada e inculta en la que se ha convertido. En camino de perder toda pasión en la vida como varios de sus colegas con exceso de trabajo, Akira encuentra su gracia salvadora de la manera más inesperada posible: el estallido de un apocalipsis zombie.

Con el tiempo libre que finalmente tiene, Akira decide completar una lista de cien cosas que quiere hacer antes de convertirse en un zombi. Aunque está rodeado de muertos, ¡Akira nunca se ha sentido más vivo!

In order to save their friends and survive on the deadly battlefield, they must fight with every ounce of courage and pride that they can muster.

Isami y Smith se cruzan durante la batalla, pero de repente, sus equipos son atacados por un enemigo desconocido, lo que dispersa a los soldados y desordena sus fuerzas. Para salvar a sus amigos y sobrevivir en el mortífero campo de batalla, deben luchar con cada gramo de coraje y orgullo que puedan reunir.

items.title: Mushoku Tensei II: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu Part 2
items.description:
Following the faceless god Hitogami's advice seems to have worked wonders for Rudeus Greyrat. After enrolling into the University of Magic as he was told, Rudeus reunites with his childhood friend Sylphiette, who put a valiant effort into curing his condition. The two grow ever closer together and decide to host a wedding party, inviting the friends they have made over the years to announce and formalize their relationship.

For all his recent blessings, however, Rudeus' troubles are far from over. The research he is helping Shizuka Nanahoshi conduct hits a bottleneck, sending her into a deep slump much like he experienced in his previous life. Furthermore, a letter from his father, Paul, brings complications to Rudeus' relationships, and Sylphiette still knows next to nothing about his real background. In the face of these issues, Rudeus will have to apply the lessons he has learned in this new world to navigate through the challenges that come with living a life to its fullest.
items.franchise: Mushoku Tensei II: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu Part 2
items.description_es:
Seguir el consejo del dios sin rostro Hitogami parece haber funcionado de maravilla para Ludeus Greyrat. Después de inscribirse en la Universidad de Magia como le dijeron, Rudeus se reúne con su amiga de la infancia Sylphiette, quien hizo un valiente esfuerzo para curar su condición. Los dos se acercan cada vez más y deciden organizar una fiesta de bodas, invitando a los amigos que han hecho a lo largo de los años a anunciar y formalizar su relación.

Sin embargo, a pesar de todas sus bendiciones recientes, los problemas de Ludeus están lejos de terminar. La investigación que está ayudando a realizar a Shizuka Nanahoshi encuentra un cuello de botella, enviándola a una profunda depresión muy parecida a la que él experimentó en su vida anterior. Además, una carta de su padre, Paul, trae complicaciones a las relaciones de Ludeus, y Sylphiette todavía no sabe casi nada sobre sus verdaderos antecedentes. Frente a estos problemas, Ludeus tendrá que aplicar las lecciones que ha aprendido en este nuevo mundo para superar los desafíos que conlleva vivir una vida al máximo.

items.description:
Lu Guang loses everything when a mysterious man bursts into the photo studio that he is renting with his close friend Cheng Xiaoshi. The man, who comes to punish the members at the studio for playing with time, murders both Qiao Ling and Cheng Xiaoshi in cold blood. However, Lu Guang inherits his friend's power to go back in time and decides to save everyone from their grim fate.

Now in the past, Lu Guang travels to Bridon to help Cheng Xiaoshi investigate his father's whereabouts; however, he discovers an uncanny series of small disparities that cause the situation to spiral into complete uncertainty. Suddenly unable to rely on his ability to predict the future, Lu Guang must invent a new strategy to foil the plans of the man who took everything from him.
items.description_es:
Lu Guang lo pierde todo cuando un hombre misterioso irrumpe en el estudio fotográfico que alquila con su amigo cercano Cheng Xiaoshi. El hombre, que viene a castigar a los miembros del estudio por jugar con el tiempo, asesina a sangre fría a Qiao Ling y Cheng Xiaoshi. Sin embargo, Lu Guang hereda el poder de su amigo para retroceder en el tiempo y decide salvar a todos de su sombrío destino.

Ya en el pasado, Lu Guang viaja a Bridon para ayudar a Cheng Xiaoshi a investigar el paradero de su padre; sin embargo, descubre una extraña serie de pequeñas disparidades que hacen que la situación se convierta en una espiral de total incertidumbre. De repente, incapaz de confiar en su capacidad para predecir el futuro, Lu Guang debe inventar una nueva estrategia para frustrar los planes del hombre que le quitó todo.

items.title: Dr. Stone: Science Future
items.description:
Having resolved the crisis in the Petrification Kingdom, Senkuu and his companions gear up to deal directly with the mastermind behind the petrification phenomenon—who supposedly resides on the moon. The ambitious spaceship project, however, requires immense manpower and critical resources scattered across the world. Thus, the Kingdom of Science exploration team kick-starts its transcontinental journey on the ship Perseus to gather them all.

Equipped with modern technology and bolstered by the new, capable members in their ranks, the exploration team feels confident about setting sail to their first destination: America. They soon realize that the region now hosts adversaries controlling the resources they need, doing so with scientific technology which rivals and even exceeds their own. In a battle of science versus science, Senkuu and his team must outsmart their rivals if they are to have any chance of ensuring the continued survival and rejuvenation of humanity.
items.description_es:
Habiendo resuelto la crisis en el Reino de Petrificación, Senkuu y sus compañeros se preparan para tratar directamente con el cerebro detrás del fenómeno de petrificación, que supuestamente reside en la luna. Sin embargo, el ambicioso proyecto de nave espacial requiere una inmensa mano de obra y recursos críticos repartidos por todo el mundo. Así, el equipo de exploración del Reino de la Ciencia inicia su viaje transcontinental en el barco Perseo para reunirlos a todos.

Equipado con tecnología moderna y reforzado por los nuevos y capaces miembros en sus filas, el equipo de exploración se siente seguro de zarpar hacia su primer destino: América. Pronto se dan cuenta de que la región ahora alberga adversarios que controlan los recursos que necesitan, y lo hacen con tecnología científica que rivaliza e incluso supera la suya. En una batalla de ciencia contra ciencia, Senkuu y su equipo deben ser más astutos que sus rivales si quieren tener alguna posibilidad de garantizar la supervivencia y el rejuvenecimiento continuos de la humanidad.

items.description:
Nestled away on the rooftop of Tenikai General Hospital is the unconventional Department of Investigative Pathology headed by the eccentric Dr. Takao Ameku. The tiny department, consisting of Takao and her sole resident Yuu "Kotori" Takanashi, treats complex cases that most other departments within the hospital cannot resolve on their own.

The mystery-obsessed Takao always tries to insert herself into cases that capture her fancy—much to the dismay of her colleagues and the police. Even if her meddling creates more problems for the hospital and those around her, none can deny the brilliance that the young department head exhibits as she weaves a diagnosis together. No matter the specialty, no case is impossible for Takao and a somewhat reluctant Takanashi to solve.

Incluso si su intromisión crea más problemas para el hospital y quienes la rodean, nadie puede negar la brillantez que exhibe la joven jefa de departamento mientras teje un diagnóstico. No importa la especialidad, ningún caso es imposible de resolver para Takao y un Takanashi algo reacio.

items.title: Mattaku Saikin no Tantei to Kitara
items.description:
In the detective business, everyone knows the name Keiichirou Nagumo. Back in high school, he was called a genius for cracking tough cases that even the police could not solve. But those days are long gone—or so the rumors say. However, one day, an unexpected visitor barges into his office: Mashiro, an energetic high school student who demands to be hired as his new assistant.

Although Keiichirou tries to brush her off, Mashiro is persistent. She is determined to become a detective, and to prove her worth, she begins by teaching him about the latest technology and offers a fresh perspective on his business. Thus, Keiichirou takes Mashiro on as his assistant and embarks on a brand new chapter in his career—one where he finds himself constantly surprised by the modern generation of detectives.
items.franchise: Mattaku Saikin no Tantei to Kitara
items.description_es:
En el negocio de los detectives, todo el mundo conoce el nombre de Keiichirou Nagumo. En la escuela secundaria, lo llamaban un genio por resolver casos difíciles que ni siquiera la policía podía resolver. Pero esos días ya pasaron, o eso dicen los rumores. Sin embargo, un día, un visitante inesperado irrumpe en su oficina: Mashiro, un enérgico estudiante de secundaria que exige ser contratado como su nuevo asistente.

Aunque Keiichirou intenta ignorarla, Mashiro es persistente. Está decidida a convertirse en detective y, para demostrar su valía, comienza enseñándole acerca de la última tecnología y le ofrece una nueva perspectiva sobre su negocio. Por lo tanto, Keiichirou toma a Mashiro como su asistente y se embarca en un nuevo capítulo en su carrera, uno en el que se encuentra constantemente sorprendido por la generación moderna de detectives.

items.description: Within the Kingdom of Ei's opulent inner court is the thriving Maiden Court, where the empress and the four imperial consorts are chosen from five prominent clans. Among them, one pristine consort-in-training, Reirin Kou, stands out as the perfect candidate for the future empress. Her virtue and elegance are unrivaled, and she is flawless—save for her extremely sickly constitution. Compared to the court's gentle butterfly, the boorish Keigetsu Shu is like a sewer rat. Always staring at Reirin with bitter envy, Keigetsu is a disgrace to the Maiden Court. During the night of a rare comet sighting, Keigetsu's jealousy reaches its peak, and she attempts to murder Reirin by pushing her off a balcony. Reirin is quickly saved from death, and Keigetsu is imprisoned to await her execution. Unbeknownst to all, Keigetsu has cast a spell to swap bodies with Reirin in order to steal all that belongs to her. But while Keigetsu is hindered by Reirin's frail body, Reirin fully embraces freedom and physical strength for the first time in her life, determined to live—no matter whose face she wears.

items.title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
items.description:
Tsukuyomi is a virtual realm where hopes and dreams come together. Iroha Sakayori, a 17-year-old high school student in Tokyo, leads an extremely busy life trying to balance part-time work and academics. She finds peace by watching a popular streamer named Yachiyo Runami, who is the administrator of an online virtual space called Tsukuyomi.

Iroha frequents Tsukuyomi, where people can live different lives and freely pursue their creativity, and she passes the time by supporting Yachiyo and playing battle games to earn a little extra money. On her way home one day, Iroha finds a telephone pole shining with iridescent hues. To her surprise, an adorable baby emerges from the pole. Unable to abandon it, Iroha takes the infant home and watches her rapidly grow into a girl her own age.

"Are you Princess Kaguya?"

The grown-up Kaguya develops a self-indulgent personality. At Kaguya's fervent request, Iroha helps her start streaming in Tsukuyomi. With Iroha as producer and songwriter and Kaguya as streamer and singer, the two grow steadily closer. Little do they know that ominous forces lie in wait, eager to take Kaguya back to the moon.

This is the tale of Princess Kaguya as never seen before.
items.description_es:
Tsukuyomi es un reino virtual donde se unen las esperanzas y los sueños. Iroha Sakayori, una estudiante de secundaria de 17 años en Tokio, lleva una vida extremadamente ocupada tratando de equilibrar el trabajo a tiempo parcial y lo académico. Encuentra la paz viendo a un popular streamer llamado Yachiyo Runami, que es el administrador de un espacio virtual en línea llamado Tsukuyomi.

Iroha frecuenta Tsukuyomi, donde las personas pueden vivir vidas diferentes y desarrollar libremente su creatividad, y pasa el tiempo apoyando a Yachiyo y jugando juegos de batalla para ganar un poco de dinero extra. Un día, de camino a casa, Iroha encuentra un poste telefónico que brilla con tonos iridiscentes. Para su sorpresa, un adorable bebé emerge del poste. Incapaz de abandonarlo, Iroha lleva a la niña a casa y la observa crecer rápidamente hasta convertirse en una niña de su misma edad.

"¿Eres la princesa Kaguya?"

La Kaguya adulta desarrolla una personalidad autoindulgente. A petición ferviente de Kaguya, Iroha la ayuda a comenzar a transmitir en Tsukuyomi. Con Iroha como productora y compositora y Kaguya como streamer y cantante, los dos se acercan cada vez más. Lo que no saben es que fuerzas siniestras acechan, ansiosas por llevar a Kaguya de regreso a la luna.

Esta es la historia de la princesa Kaguya como nunca antes se había visto.

items.description: The world's first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality. Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman. Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

Emirun y Rex, que alguna vez se conocieron en el mundo real, se reúnen por casualidad dentro de SAO. Se unen a un grupo de exploración para aprender cómo sobrevivir en este mundo implacable. Un día, sin embargo, se encuentran con un misterioso PK (Player Killer) conocido sólo como Black Swordsman. Cuando Emirun corre a la escena, encuentra a Rex colapsado por la desesperación y al Espadachín Negro de pie junto a él. El que acabó con todo su grupo de exploración fue el Espadachín Negro. Decididos a vengar a sus camaradas caídos, Emirun y Rex buscan a la legendaria espadachín prodigio Asuna y comienzan un intenso entrenamiento bajo su guía.
